items.summary: Financial recommendation: reject the Fleet Execution Integrity and Capacity-Gated Delivery proposal as duplicate control-plane work and maintain containment-only execution. Authorize no spend, billing changes, money movement, monetization expansion, or new queue admissions. The only supported revenue result is Amazon data for 2026-09-21: 6,219 aggregate clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; it is unattributed, so site revenue claims are unsupported. September 1-30 AI usage was $950.44 across 5,316 calls with 229 errors, but it cannot be compared with one revenue day. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, forecasts, infrastructure spend, total budget exposure, and cost-to-learn are unknown because matching-period allocated revenue and costs, budget limits, and an approved learning threshold are absent. Minimum measurement: a dated same-period ledger mapping revenue, AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, and other costs to site/content identifiers, plus an approved learning threshold. Continue the existing period-aligned reconciliation only.

Retain only the existing period-aligned finance reconciliation. Preserve the 2026-09-21 Amazon aggregate result as unattributed; do not extrapolate September AI spend into revenue, margin, ROI, payback, or forecast claims. No duplicate finance request or new telemetry is needed.
